magicLink.subject: Your AltyDetect sign-in link ({host})
magicLink.intro: Click the button below to sign in to AltyDetect. This link is valid for 30 minutes and works only once.
magicLink.ignore: Didn't request this link? Ignore this email: no account will be created or changed.

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.subtitle: Get a sign-in link by email, no password needed.

signUp.title: Create an account
signUp.subtitle: Free, no credit card. We'll email you a confirmation link.
signUp.consent: By creating an account, you accept the <terms>terms of use</terms> and the <privacy>privacy policy</privacy>.

auth.invalidEmail: Enter a valid email address, for example name@example.com.
auth.error: Sign-in didn't go through. Try again or request a new link.

verify.title: Check your inbox
verify.body: We've just sent you a sign-in link. It's valid for 30 minutes. Check your spam folder too.

trial.saveBody: Save it to your history to find it later.
